stories.title: Trump urged Xi to talk to Takaichi and lift export curbs on Japan, sources say

en.title: Trump urged Xi to talk to Takaichi and lift export curbs on Japan, sources say
en.summary: During a meeting in Washington, US President Trump pressed Chinese leader Xi Jinping to remove export restrictions China has placed on Japan and encouraged direct talks between Chinese and Japanese officials. Xi also raised concerns about increasing Japanese military activities during their discussions.

stories.title: Can the Gulf aviation superhub model survive the war?

en.title: Can the Gulf aviation superhub model survive the war?
en.summary: Gulf airports in Dubai, Doha, and Abu Dhabi have long served as major connection points for passengers traveling between Asia and the West, handling 182 million passengers annually. The article examines whether this hub-and-spoke aviation model can persist amid ongoing regional conflict.

stories.title: Venezuela’s Maduro to face new US charges over alleged torture of Americans, official says

en.title: Venezuela's Maduro to face new US charges over alleged torture of Americans, official says
en.summary: Former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife are expected to face additional criminal charges in the United States for allegedly torturing Americans. The charges could be filed as soon as Thursday, according to a US official.

stories.title: Evicted 87-year-old woman Maricarmen, heart of Spain’s housing protests, has died

en.title: Evicted 87-year-old woman Maricarmen, heart of Spain's housing protests, has died
en.summary: An 87-year-old Spanish woman whose eviction in September triggered nationwide housing protests has died following her removal from her home of over 70 years. Her death has prompted renewed grief and anger among protesters in Madrid.

stories.title: New York’s famed Chrysler Building finally finds a buyer

en.title: New York's famed Chrysler Building finally finds a buyer
en.summary: A US real estate firm led by Tishman Speyer announced it is purchasing the iconic Chrysler Building and will invest $235 million to renovate the 1930 art deco landmark's aging interior and exterior.

stories.title: US issues first outbound investment fine over Chinese robotics AI deal

en.title: US issues first outbound investment fine over Chinese robotics AI deal
en.summary: The US Treasury issued its first penalty under investment rules for sensitive Chinese technologies, fining the parent company of Plug and Play Tech Centre $200,000 for failing to report a roughly $92,478 investment in a Shanghai robotics AI company.

stories.title: Canada will not allow assisted suicide for those with only mental illness

en.title: Canada will not allow assisted suicide for those with only mental illness
en.summary: Canada's justice minister announced the country will not permit medically assisted suicide for people whose sole condition is mental illness, limiting the practice to end-of-life care and serious incurable illnesses.

stories.title: Trump wants to turn his Florida golf course into presidential retreat

en.title: Trump wants to turn his Florida golf course into presidential retreat
en.summary: President Trump proposes converting his Trump International Golf Club in West Palm Beach into an official presidential retreat for future American leaders, modeled after Camp David.

stories.title: 分子也有“左右之分”，今年诺贝尔化学奖为何研究“偏心”？

en.title: Molecules have "left and right sides" - why does this year's Nobel Chemistry Prize research "chirality"?
en.summary: The Swedish Royal Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 Nobel Chemistry Prize to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai for discovering nonlinear effects and autocatalytic phenomena in asymmetric organic synthesis.

stories.title: US proposes US$70,000 fee for foreign students to work after graduation

en.title: US proposes US$70,000 fee for foreign students to work after graduation
en.summary: The United States Department of Homeland Security proposed requiring schools to pay US$70,000 for each foreign student participating in Optional Practical Training programs, with an additional US$30,000 charge for further participation.

stories.title: 尹锡悦接受免费舆论调查服务案二审改判无罪

en.title: Yoon Suk-yeol acquitted on appeal in case of receiving free opinion survey services
en.summary: South Korea's former president Yoon Suk-yeol was acquitted on appeal in a case involving allegations that he received free opinion survey services. Some guilty verdicts from the initial trial were overturned.

stories.title: France halts use of stun grenades in policing of student protests

en.title: France halts use of stun grenades in policing of student protests
en.summary: France suspended stun grenade use during student protest policing following an incident where a 15-year-old's hand was severely injured. Student protests continue with hundreds of schools closed and additional demonstrations planned.

stories.title: Hong Kong tech index to harness fast-growth companies in bid for better performance

en.title: Hong Kong tech index to harness fast-growth companies in bid for better performance
en.summary: Hong Kong's stock index compiler will add 10 fast-growing companies with at least HK$500 million in annual sales to its technology benchmark. The reform aims to revitalise the Hang Seng Tech Index, which has underperformed global peers and missed gains from artificial intelligence trends.

stories.title: Why Morgan Stanley sees more upside in Hong Kong offices than New York towers

en.title: Why Morgan Stanley sees more upside in Hong Kong offices than New York towers
en.summary: Morgan Stanley believes Hong Kong's office market has greater upside potential than New York despite higher interest rates affecting both property markets. The investment bank notes similarities between the two financial centers, including aligned monetary policies and limited land supply.

stories.title: Family offices branch out into private equity, infrastructure and alternative investments

en.title: Family offices branch out into private equity, infrastructure and alternative investments
en.summary: Asian family offices led by second and third-generation owners are expanding into diverse investment areas including private equity and infrastructure rather than abandoning founding principles. These investors continue assessing opportunities and adjusting portfolios for optimal risk-return balance.

stories.title: Asian investors turn to housing, real assets as global tension shakes market confidence

en.title: Asian investors turn to housing, real assets as global tension shakes market confidence
en.summary: Asian investors are shifting away from private credit toward real estate and other real assets amid macroeconomic uncertainties. Interest in real estate rose to 52 percent from 39 percent while private credit interest dropped significantly to 48 percent from 71 percent.

stories.title: US firm ArriVent’s plunge shows risks facing China’s biotech expansion into global markets

en.title: US firm ArriVent's plunge shows risks facing China's biotech expansion into global markets
en.summary: ArriVent BioPharma's stock fell nearly 47 percent after its cancer drug firmonertinib, licensed from Shanghai Allist Pharmaceuticals, failed to meet primary objectives in a phase 3 trial. The setback illustrates challenges Chinese biotech companies face when expanding internationally.
